author: WindyRoses
quote: Not allowed it has to be squeezed into one bag. And they are pedantic bastards about this
paraphrase: Everything must fit in one bag; staff very strict.

author: W0tnow
quote: I take a small handbag that I can fit into my underseat bag
paraphrase: Packs small handbag inside underseat bag.

author: TY78910
quote: I've had my handbag on under my jacket before

author: ExtraDecluttering
quote: I did get on with one of the uniqlo cross body ones under a zipped coat recently
paraphrase: Boarded with crossbody hidden under zipped coat.

author: BronwenFrideswide
quote: (and it is a very small bag I don't know how people manage with just that bag!) And they are strict about it.

author: FortyElephants
quote: You have to be sneaky with Ryanair.
paraphrase: Hide handbag in duty free carrier.

author: ItisIbeserk
quote: EasyJet are the same (although enforcement is irritatingly variable).

author: CountTo10
quote: one of them stood over a poor women further down the queue whilst she tried to squeeze her hand bag and contents
paraphrase: Staff loomed over a woman squeezing handbag into carry-on.

author: minnienono
quote: I've seen carrier bags inspected at the gate to ensure they are duty free and people charged for an extra bag.
paraphrase: Seen duty free bags inspected and people charged.

author: garlictwist

author: clary
quote: I have put a small, empty crossbody bag in my Ryanair backpack

author: clary
quote: I have a 40x20x25 bag I got on Amazon

author: valder
quote: I found that a soft leather passport holder worn cross body is never checked, or at least hasn't ever been for me YET!

author: ASongbirdAndAnOldHat

author: stayathomer
quote: She fit hers in fine but they were talking about her having to pay for her second bag

author: Sossusvlei
